message.content:
London’s official time zone is **GMT** (Greenwich Mean Time) during the winter months.  
When daylight‑saving time is in effect (roughly late March – late October), London switches to **BST** (British Summer Time), which is GMT + 1 hour.

So:

| Season | Time zone abbreviation | UTC offset |
|--------|------------------------|------------|
| Winter | GMT                    | UTC + 0    |
| Summer | BST                    | UTC + 1    |

If you need the exact current local time in London right now, let me know and I can fetch it for you.
